units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 15:8">Ex. R. s. 15</cite> <he>ונעל המ׳ בפניה</he> he locked the enclosure up before it (the cattle).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 5:4:3">Y. B. Kam. V, 4ᵈ</cite> bot.; ib. VI, 5ᵇ bot. (in Chald. diction) <he>דאית לה מ׳</he> (not <he>ליה</he>) when it (the stack of grain) has an enclosure around it.
